name: Animate Fire
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level druid 1, shaman 1

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, M (a pinch of ash)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one small fire

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You animate a fire the size of a campfire. For the duration, the animated fire has the statistics of a small fire elemental. At the end of the duration, the animated fire and the original fire are extinguished. The animated fire cannot move beyond the range of the spell from the caster.
